data_spans.label: CharMasks
data_spans.provenance: Restored local mask table from the ROM.

edits.description: Reconstructed GetFontName, GetFOND, GetFNum, SetFontLock, RealFont, SetFScaleDisable, FontMetrics, and BuildCharTable in ROM order. Preserved applicable original comments and the FontMgr.a descriptive header.
Restored the D3 and stack use in GetFontName. The routine passes scratch addresses to GetResInfo, invalidates the cached FOND afterward, and clears a word for a missing name.

Restored the cached GetFOND implementation. Family 1 maps to ApFontID. LastFOND stores the saved purge state in its high byte; WidthListHand stores the FOND flag byte. The return value masks out that high byte.
Restored the 270-byte GetFNum stack frame, D3 flag, two resource searches, and scratch result fields. The later source history records the stack reduction in August 1986.
Restored the direct handle purge-bit operations and stack use in SetFontLock. RealFont retains the older size search and rejects size zero for the FONT resource path.
SetFScaleDisable invalidates CurFMFamily and calls InValWidths. The ROM has no adjacent SetFractEnable routine.

FontMetrics saves A2 and A3, reads WidthPtr for the width-style adjustment, and calls the internal fixed-point helpers. ScaleFVal pushes the denominator before the numerator, as the ROM requires; the patch history records reversing those instructions in May 1986.

BuildCharTable saves A2 through A4 and uses a local mask table. It sign-extends the table size, omits the later extended offset handling, and calculates each band height before updating the character height. The later patch postpones the subtraction until all bands finish.
Defined the 17 local mask words from the ROM as DC.W values. They contain mask data.
Copied the required ToolUtils.a global and font-field equates and FontMgrPatch.a width-table and FOND equates. Added verified addresses for external routines, trap words, and supporting globals.
Made the ROM branch sizes and PC addressing explicit. Used ADDQ for the one-pixel ascent adjustment.
This file covers the Font Manager suffix. InitFonts, FMSwapFont, font selection, and preceding helper routines remain outside this module.

patch_instruction_edits.original:
; reversed next 2 lines	<28May86>
			MOVE.W	(A1),-(SP)			;push V output numer
			MOVE.W	4(A1),-(SP) 			;push V output denom
patch_instruction_edits.restored:
MOVE.W	4(A1),-(SP) 			;push V output denom
			MOVE.W	(A1),-(SP)			;push V output numer

patch_instruction_edits.original:
_GetMaskTable
			MOVE.L	A0,A5				;keep pointer to left masks around

patch_instruction_edits.restored:
ADD.W	D5,D5				;compute size of table
			EXT.L	D5

patch_instruction_edits.original:
IF	bugFix	THEN
			MOVE.W	fNDescent(A1),D0		;possibly the high word of owTLoc
			BLE.S	@negative
			SWAP	D0					;put it in the high word
		ENDIF
@negative

MOVEQ	#16,D4				;useful constant!
			MOVE	D4,D1				;at most 16 used
MOVE.L	RightMask(A5,D1),D2	;get inverse mask in high word
patch_instruction_edits.restored:
MOVE.L	CharMasks(PC,D1),D2
			NOT.L	D2				;get inverse mask in high word

MOVEQ	#0,D4				;D4 is current top
			MOVE.L	(A3),A0 				;get font pointer

verification.method: Called Reconstruction/Tools/verify.py verify_module in an independent temporary directory. The verifier assembled for MC68000, linked at the ROM address, checked entry points and relocations, and compared every emitted byte.
verification.scope: The entire emitted span matches the ROM. MPW assembly has not been run. Byte equality does not establish the original source formatting.
